newsitem.title: THAILAND: Natural Park asks for delay on debts.
newsitem.headline: Natural Park asks for delay on debts.

text.p: Thai property developer Natural Park Plc said on Tuesday that it was negotiating with its creditor, Thai Fuji Finance and Securities Co Ltd, for a delay in its debt repayments.
The company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it was restructuring its liabilities and had stopped repaying both the interest and principal to the finance company.

Analysts told Reuters that the company's total debts owed to Thai Fuji Finance were not known and they believed that negotiations on the postponement of debt settlement would probably meet with deadlock.
They said Natural Park's debts to equity ratio now stood at about 220 percent.
The company's balance sheet showed Natural Park has long-term debt of about seven billion baht ($269.2 million) and a short-term debt of around 6.3 billion baht.

Natural Park officials were not available for comment. The company's stock closed on Tuesday at 6.50 baht a share, unchanged from Friday. The market was closed on Monday for the Coronation Day holiday.
